breaks.php: Never returns. wp_kses_split2() repeats wp_kses() on a comment's text until it stops changing; `</<i>` becomes `</<i>>` and every later pass adds another `>`, so the loop runs until PHP's time or memory limit.
breaks.port: Gives a comment or invalid-markup token at most 16 passes to settle and drops the token when it has not. Every corpus input settles within 2 passes.
breaks.reason: No input may make kses do runaway work (design: Security). A post containing `<!--</<i>` would otherwise pin a server worker forever.
breaks.why: No input may make kses do runaway work (design: Security). A post containing `<!--</<i>` would otherwise pin a server worker forever.

breaks.php: Throws TypeError: wp_kses_attr() passes a tag's value to array_filter() whenever it is neither empty() nor true, so a non-array value crashes the request.
breaks.port: Keeps the tag with every attribute denied, as kses treats any other non-array value.
breaks.why: A malformed allowlist entry should not crash kses; the port's output is the safest reading (no attributes).

breaks.input: comments nested by writing each <!-- as <<!--!-- (or the same with </1 wrappers), about sqrt(n) levels deep
breaks.php: Finishes, but in time that grows about as n^1.5 (2.8 s for 320 KB in stock 7.1.5).
breaks.port: The nested passes of one wp_kses() call may process 32 bytes per input byte plus 64 KB in all; a token past that is dropped. Normal content uses a few times its length.
breaks.why: No input may make kses do runaway work (design: Security, bounded work).

breaks.input: an allowlist rule 'values' => '_blank' (a string, not a list)
breaks.php: Throws TypeError from in_array() when the attribute is checked.
breaks.port: No value matches: the attribute is removed.
breaks.why: A malformed rule fails closed instead of allowing any value.

breaks.input: an allowlist rule 'value_callback' that nothing can call (Rust callers with no bridge for it)
breaks.why: A malformed rule fails closed instead of allowing any value.

breaks.input: a wp_kses_uri_attributes filter that returns a non-array
breaks.php: Throws TypeError from in_array() when an attribute is checked.
breaks.port: WordPress's own URI attribute list is used, so URLs are still protocol-checked.
breaks.why: A broken filter fails closed: URL attributes are never left unchecked.
